Namkeen nahi, meethi sev se bana Sev Ka Kalakand – Mumbai ki shaan, Singhar Ji Ki Mithai sirf 20 minute mein!
Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani ki tried & tested recipe: mawa, doodh aur meethi sev se bani ye special mithai Diwali, kirtan aur mehmaan-nawazi ke liye perfect hai. Bina paneer, bina ghanton ki mehnat.
Sev Ka Kalakand ki step-by-step recipe: mawa bhunne se set karne tak
Sev, mawa, chini aur doodh ka perfect ratio (jitna sev utna doodh)
Mawa na ho toh kya karein, aur fridge mein 2-3 din kaise rakhein
Bina paneer, sirf 20 minute, kam ghee
